paper.title: Color Matching Using Hypernetwork-Based Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks

official_repository.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 with an explicit academic-research-only notice

method_facts.renderer: a convolutional/attention hypernetwork predicts spatially varying KAN spline and residual weights at every pixel; the KAN directly returns final image RGB
method_facts.unsupervised_training: two generators and two patch discriminators with CycleGAN adversarial, cycle and identity losses
method_facts.operator_topology: spatially varying per-pixel spline coefficients and residual weights, not a single bounded global colour operator
method_facts.reported_data: Volga2K paired camera captures plus Adobe FiveK, Samsung2iPhone and Zurich task-specific datasets
method_facts.published_grid: five intervals with cubic splines over [0,1] in the Volga2K unsupervised example
method_facts.published_guarantees: no project-grade output-range, cube-boundary, positive-Jacobian, inverse, spatial-consistency or severe-artifact guarantee

reason: cmKAN's unsupervised lane is an adversarial CycleGAN system, and its content encoder predicts spatially varying per-pixel spline parameters that directly generate final RGB. This violates the project's deterministic explicit-renderer boundary, permits content/spatial shortcuts, and lacks the structural and severe-artifact guarantees required for Style-safe promotion. Its research-only licence and camera-pair datasets also do not supply eligible named-stock evidence.
allowed_reuse: retain the paper and pinned source as an external non-film colour-matching baseline
study KAN spline parameterization only as a representation prior for a separately bounded global operator
reuse Volga2K only after a separate dataset lineage, rights, leakage and task-fit audit
compare published claims conceptually against explicit global LUT and diffeomorphic-flow candidates
forbidden_actions: run or train the CycleGAN path as a Style-safe film simulator
allow a neural network to directly output final RGB
treat spatially varying content-conditioned weights as a stock response
use camera-to-camera pairs as film evidence
download checkpoints or datasets without a separately frozen experiment and lineage gate
claim calibrated, stock-specific or identified unpaired digital-to-film transport
next_candidate: continue the bounded explicit-flow S3/S4/U1 chain; if KANs are revisited, constrain them to predict a single image-global monotone/cube-safe parameter set and test only after a distinct preregistration
claim_ceiling: paper/source/method audit only; no reproduction, data eligibility, image, film, stock, preference, calibration or artifact evidence
